subject: How to Rob a Bank (2026 film)
query: is how to rob a bank a true story
title: Is How to Rob a Bank a true story? The 2026 Nicholas Hoult movie
answer: The 2026 movie How to Rob a Bank, starring Nicholas Hoult, is a heist action comedy written by Mark Bianculli, and its studio descriptions and director interviews don't credit any real case. The true story with the same title is a different film: Netflix's 2024 documentary about 1990s Seattle-area bank robber Scott Scurlock.
body:
How to Rob a Bank, directed by David Leitch (Bullet Train, The Fall Guy), opens in U.S. theaters on Nov. 13, 2026, from Amazon MGM Studios. It was first set for Sept. 4, 2026. Its premise, as Complex described it in a Nov. 2 interview with Leitch, follows "a viral group of bank robbers that share their exploits on YouTube for the world to see." Leitch said he had "always wanted to do a heist movie."

The cast includes Nicholas Hoult as Ryan, Zoë Kravitz as Reagan Gardner, Pete Davidson as Vince, John C. Reilly as Agent West, Christian Slater as Walton and Tati Gabrielle as Skyler, with Anna Sawai and Rhenzy Feliz. Filming began in Pittsburgh in June 2025, and the movie runs 122 minutes.

The name causes confusion because Netflix released a documentary called How to Rob a Bank in 2024. That film tells the real story of Scott Scurlock, who carried out a string of bank robberies in the Seattle area in the 1990s. The two films are unrelated.
in_the_news: David Leitch's heist comedy How to Rob a Bank, with Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz, opens in U.S. theaters on Nov. 13, 2026.

faq.q: Is How to Rob a Bank (2026) based on a real story?
faq.a: No real case is credited. It is a heist comedy from a script by Mark Bianculli.

faq.q: Is How to Rob a Bank about Scott Scurlock?
faq.a: The 2024 Netflix documentary How to Rob a Bank is about Scott Scurlock. The 2026 Nicholas Hoult movie is a separate film.

faq.q: When does How to Rob a Bank come out?
Who is in the cast of How to Rob a Bank?
faq.a: Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, Pete Davidson, John C. Reilly, Christian Slater, Tati Gabrielle, Anna Sawai and Rhenzy Feliz.

faq.q: Who directed How to Rob a Bank?
faq.a: David Leitch, who also directed Bullet Train and The Fall Guy.
